(a) Red: on a worktree of ded3e4b with 07d44c0's store_layer_test.go, TestAppendAfterRejectedIDKeepsClock fails on its own assertion (the millisecond line), not on a build error. (b) Green: on 07d44c0 it passes. (c) Removal: on 07d44c0, replace the ValidID loop in AppendWith with last = evs[len(evs)-1].ID; the test fails. (d) go vet ./... and go test ./... -count=1 pass on 07d44c0; go test -v -run for the six line tests (TestSandboxStoreCut... names as in store_layer_test.go and cmd tests) passes with none skipped (lsof is on PATH). (e) A fresh subagent reviews git diff 9643341 07d44c0 outside investigations/ against lines 1 to 6 and the owner's answers; its reply is saved word for word as e-review.md. H-T83XWY supports when (a) to (d) hold and the review names no defect that is a case of a line; contradicts when (b), (c) or (d) fails; inconclusive when (a) fails (the test does not separate). The Result closes R-YYCWTP#1 whatever the verdicts, applies R-YYCWTP#r1, and closes each line whose test ran in (d).
